product.description:
Bourjois Always Fabulous 2-in-1 Foundcealer Stick combines the benefits of foundation and concealer in one convenient stick. The 400 Rose Beige shade is designed to help create an even-looking complexion with a smooth, natural-looking finish.

Its creamy texture glides easily onto the skin, providing buildable coverage to help conceal blemishes, dark circles, and uneven skin tone. The convenient built-in blender makes application and blending easy, whether you're getting ready for everyday wear or creating a more polished makeup look.

Key Benefits

  • 2-in-1 foundation and concealer.

  • Helps conceal imperfections and uneven skin tone.

  • Buildable coverage for a smooth-looking complexion.

  • Convenient stick format for easy application.

  • Includes a built-in blender for effortless blending.

  • Ideal for everyday makeup and on-the-go touch-ups.

 

How to Use

  1. Start with clean, moisturized skin.

  2. Apply the stick directly to your forehead, cheeks, nose, chin, and areas that need extra coverage.

  3. Use the built-in blender to blend the product evenly into your skin.

  4. Add another layer where more coverage is needed.

  5. Finish with setting powder if desired for a more long-lasting makeup look.

Suitable For

Anyone looking for convenient foundation and concealer coverage in one product.
